notes.title: Indie Playtest Fest
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Indie Playtest Fest starts the 1st of August. Several Indie games have been selected for a playtest for their games at the same time, AND the games are giving away prizes for playing and submitting your feedback!

Play Zombiology this month and submit a survey about the game for a chance to win a $50 or $20 Steam gift card. Play additional games for Indie Playtest Fest and get more chances to win more prizes.

Here's how it works:
[olist]
[*]Play Zombiology's playtest demo here Steam. Click "Request Access" and then check your Steam client. 
[*]Try to complete the full demo. (Get to the Thank You screen after about 20 levels)
[*]Email your playlog to info@doublezgames.com -- (See instructions in feedback form)
[*]Fill out the feedback form. See links below...
[/olist]

For more information check out the Indie Playtest Fest website here:
[url=https://www.indieplaytestfest.com/]Indie Playtest Fest[/url]

Feedback Form:
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdjeQALz7EokdEYQ_6-BCCPZZlafecqfg-0Y3ZnrhaLLGci8A/viewform]Feedback Google Form[/url]
